justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: >90% BPPV resolution with CRP; chronic vestibular dysfunction shows consistent improvement in dizziness and balance.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 2-day course standard; multiple providers; moderate cost ~$300-600; widely accessible.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Very common referral pattern; vestibular dysfunction seen across general outpatient, neuro, and geriatric caseloads.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Billed under balance training and therapeutic exercise PT codes; Medicare and commercial coverage standard; ENT referral pathway strong.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: High employer demand in outpatient PT and neuro specialty; vestibular training frequently listed as preferred or required.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: High when BPPV resolved in 1-2 visits; dramatic symptom relief creates strong satisfaction.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Mostly insurance-reimbursed via referrals; cash-pay niche exists but is secondary.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Specialty status supports premium positioning and strong referral networks.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Relatively few certified vestibular PTs in most markets; meaningful differentiation.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Other clinicians can be trained and certified; scales well within a practice.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Patients seek out vestibular specialists; ENTs and neurologists drive referrals.
justifications.business.efficiency: APTA/Emory/Duke courses are moderate cost and time; efficient credential.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Highly respected; pairs naturally with NCS board specialty.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Strong, mature literature including Cochrane reviews.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Core content in DPT neuro curricula.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Excellent; BPPV and unilateral hypofunction treatments are evidence-based standards.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Commonly preferred for neuro faculty positions.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Reasonable time investment for high academic return.
